text: The third most important use of blockchain by private investment funds is support for fund growth, which is consistent with anecdotal evidence that returns attainable through crypto investments have no match in traditional finance.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Blockchain Innovation for Private Investment Funds (2017). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2998033

isBasedOn.name: Blockchain Innovation for Private Investment Funds

abstract: The third most important category of private investment fund use of blockchain technology pertains to its support for the growth of the fund. This is consistent with anecdotal evidence suggesting that the crypto returns attainable through crypto investments have no match in traditional finance.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: based on word cluster coding of fund marketing materials; the return comparison is characterized as anecdotal
